a2-unit-35.35.1 Planning a day out:
Narrator: It's Wednesday evening in Chicago. Tom, Lucy and their roommate Priya are planning a day out at Indiana Dunes National Park on Saturday.
Lucy: So, is everyone still up for the Dunes on Saturday?
Tom: Yes, definitely!
Priya: Of course! I really need a day away from the library.
Lucy: Great. We can take the South Shore Line train from downtown to Dune Park, and then we can walk to the trails. Tom, are you going to get the train tickets again?
Tom: Yes, I am. I'm going to buy them on the app, like last time.
Priya: Perfect. We can pay you back later.
Lucy: And I'm going to plan our hike on the map tonight.
Tom: Just like you always do. You're a great leader!
Priya: What about food? I'll bake some bread tonight and make sandwiches for everyone. Why don't we all bring our own drinks?
Lucy: That sounds like a good idea. Thanks!
Tom: Why don't I get some fruit and some chips for after lunch?
Priya: Yes please!
Lucy: I checked the weather forecast, and it's going to be really hot on Saturday. We'll all need hats. I'll bring a big bottle of sunscreen, and we can share it. Let's leave early so it's not too hot for the hike.
Tom: Good idea. And let's bring towels and bathing suits so we can swim in Lake Michigan after the hike!
Priya: Yes! I've never swum in a lake before.
Lucy: How about stopping at Kate's bakery on the way home? She's selling her coffee ice cream now.
Tom: Ha! You just want free ice cream from my sister.
Priya: It sounds like a perfect day out. I can't wait!
